name: toolsmith-history-add
intent: Add one new entry file to the project's docs/history log.
use_when: You finished a unit of work and the project history log procedure says to record it before committing.
You would otherwise build the docs/history/<date>/<timestamp>-<slug>.md path with date, mkdir and a heredoc.
not_for: Reading or searching the log: use find, cat or grep on docs/history.
Changing an existing entry: entries are immutable.
Migrating a legacy single-file log (docs/HISTORY.md): that needs its own numbered file names.
input: The title as the first argument: a short headline for the entry, made into the file's slug (lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 60 characters). The entry text on stdin: standalone markdown, written exactly as given, with a final newline added when missing. Empty text is refused.

options.text: Write the file but do not run `git add` on it.

output: Stdout is the new file's path, relative to the current directory. The file goes in the docs/history of the nearest directory at or above the current one that has docs/history; when none has, in a new docs/history at the git repository root. Its name is docs/history/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<unix-time>-<slug>.md with today's local date. An existing file is never overwritten. Inside a git repository the file is staged with `git add`, so it lands in the next commit with the work it describes.

exit_codes.text: The entry was written (and staged, inside a git repository).
No entry, or an unstaged one: no project found, the file exists, or a write or `git add` failed.
Nothing written: the title, the text or the arguments are wrong.

examples.title: Add an entry at the repository root
examples.stdin: - Crawled staging: 557 URLs, 3 broken internal links fixed.

files_after.docs/history/*/*-seo-review-of-staging.m: - Crawled staging: 557 URLs, 3 broken internal links fixed.

examples.title: From deep inside an app that has its own docs/history
Outside any project
examples.stderr: toolsmith-history-add: no docs/history directory above here and not inside a git repository; run this from inside the project

examples.title: Empty entry text is refused
examples.stderr:
toolsmith-history-add: the entry text on stdin is empty
Run `toolsmith-history-add --help` for usage, or `toolsmith-history-add --llm` for the full guide.
